articles.title: Enemies Turned Business Partners: Israelis and Palestinians Build Startups Together
articles.summary: What if your business partner was from the other side of a war? That's what's happening in a program called 50:50 Startups. Salah Hussein, a Palestinian, and Yana Shaulov, an Israeli, are working together on a bug-detecting camera for greenhouses. They're showing that cooperation is possible, even when it's hard.

articles.title: Hong Kong's First Astronaut Blasts Off on a Yearlong Space Mission!
articles.summary: A rocket just launched three astronauts to China's space station, and one of them is making history! Lai Ka-ying is the first astronaut from Hong Kong. She'll help with science experiments, and one crew member will stay in space for a whole year to see how the human body handles it.

articles.title: 20 Times on Top of the World! Meet the Everest Guide Who Just Won't Quit
articles.summary: Kenton Cool, a British mountain guide, just climbed Mount Everest for the 20th time—a new record for a non-Sherpa! He's 52 and says he might do it two or three more times. This year, 274 climbers reached the top in a single day, but Cool says his team had no crowds and a great summit.
